description: This Java class 'DefaultAmqp091Config' provides the default configuration implementation for AMQP 0.9.1 messaging protocol within the Eclipse Ditto project. It handles configuration settings related to publisher acknowledgment timeout values, parsing them from a config object.

classes.name: DefaultAmqp091Config
classes.description: Immutable configuration class for AMQP 0.9.1, providing publisher pending acknowledgment timeout settings.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultAmqp091Config from a Typesafe Config object.

methods.name: getPublisherPendingAckTTL
methods.description: Returns the publisher pending acknowledgment TTL duration.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on TTL configuration.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on the publisher pending acknowledgment TTL.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides string representation of the configuration object.
